movie.title: Unsubmissives
movie.overview: Early 1990’s, south of France. Katy, Hélène, Laurence and Carole have been best friends since childhood. Now in their twenties, they find themselves struggling with hardship and limited opportunities in their sunny small hometown. Despite their challenging circumstances, they have maintained a resilient and cheerful spirit, supporting each other throughout life’s ups and downs. But their lives take a dramatic turn when Hélène, a single mother of three, receives a sudden notification that her welfare checks have been reduced, threatening her ability to support her family.Overwhelmed by this injustice and feeling powerless in the face of societal inequalities, the five women are driven by a fierce desire to change the course of their lives. They make the shocking decision to rob a bank, and soon, commit a series of increasingly daring heists.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In the early 1990s south of France, four lifelong friends driven by financial hardship and systemic injustice pull off a series of increasingly daring bank heists to reclaim control over their lives.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Set in the sunny south of France during the early 1990s, four lifelong friends—Katy, Hélène, Laurence, and Carole—struggle to make ends meet amidst limited local opportunities. When Hélène, a single mother of three, loses a vital portion of her welfare checks, the women reach their breaking point against systemic injustice. Refusing to accept their bleak circumstances, they embark on a dangerous path by robbing a local bank. What begins as a desperate act quickly escalates into a series of increasingly daring criminal heists.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a small, sunny town in the south of France during the early 1990s, Katy, Hélène, Laurence, and Carole share a bond forged in childhood. Now in their twenties, the four women face severe economic hardship, finding themselves trapped by a lack of local opportunities despite maintaining a supportive, resilient friendship. The fragile stability of their lives is shattered when Hélène, a single mother raising three children, receives a notice that her welfare benefits have been drastically reduced. Devastated and unable to feed her family, Hélène's plight exposes the harsh reality of societal inequalities to her fiercely loyal friends. Driven by frustration and a burning desire for justice, the group decides that traditional methods will no longer suffice to change their fortunes. In a desperate and shocking turn of events, they band together to execute a bank robbery to secure their financial survival. The initial success empowers them, sparking a wave of defiance against a system that abandoned them. As their confidence grows, the women orchestrate a series of increasingly daring and complex heists throughout the region. Ultimately, their journey tests the strength of their lifelong friendship as they navigate the thrilling yet dangerous world of crime.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of the early 1990s in the south of France, Unsubmissives follows the lives of four lifelong friends—Katy, Hélène, Laurence, and Carole—who are struggling to build meaningful futures in their impoverished small hometown. Despite facing severe economic stagnation and limited prospects, their bond remains unshakable as they support one another through every hardship. However, their resilient spirit is put to the ultimate test when Hélène, a devoted single mother of three, suffers a devastating cut to her government welfare checks, threatening her ability to keep her family fed and sheltered. Pushed to the brink by systemic unfairness and administrative indifference, the women unite with a fierce determination to take control of their own destinies. Unwilling to remain victims of their circumstances, they hatch a radical plan to rob a local bank, catapulting them into a high-stakes crime wave of bold heists. Unsubmissives is a tense, emotional drama exploring friendship, female empowerment, and the extreme lengths people will go to survive when left behind by society.
